projects.name: DocuFlow
projects.description: DocuFlow is a fully serverless, cloud-native document approval system built on AWS. It streamlines document submissions, multi-level approvals, notifications, and version control for internal enterprise workflows. The system aims to be lightweight, scalable, and cost-efficient, making it ideal for organizations seeking automated and auditable document lifecycle management without managing servers or complex infrastructure.

projects.name: ResuMate
projects.description: ResuMate is a cloud-based AI-powered web application that assists job seekers in creating personalized cover letters tailored to specific job descriptions. It streamlines the application process by combining user resume data with job postings to generate highly relevant, professional cover letters.

projects.name: Neighbourhood Crime Insights
projects.description: Neighbourhood Crime Insights (NCI) is a data-driven project that explores the spatial and socio-economic patterns of crime in Nova Scotia. Using unsupervised clustering techniques, particularly HDBSCAN, this system analyzes over 24,000 records of crime reports combined with demographic data from the 2016 and 2021 Canada Census to detect high-risk regions and derive community-level insights.

projects.name: MomentReely
projects.description: It is a photo-sharing application designed to foster personal connections through visual storytelling. It enables users to create accounts, connect with friends, and share photos seamlessly within the platform. The resoning behind this project was not to create a photo sharing application, but rather learn AWS Cloud & Kotlin Mobile Application Development.

projects.name: Software Vizualizer - SoftViz
projects.description: A tool that identifies class-level dependencies in JAR files (via inheritance, implementation, and composition) and generates interactive visualizations of software structures. Supports project management by letting users save, reload, and modify dependency analyses for iterative evaluation.

projects.name: MalwareMinder
projects.description: A malware detection system for android OS, created using machine learning algorithms. It implements ensemble learning to improve accuracy and reduce false positives. The system was developed using Python and Flutter along with cloud services using Digital Ocean.

projects.name: SafetyNet: Industrial Safety System
projects.description: An IOT based safety system that monitors the safety of workers in an industrial environment. The system uses sensors to detect hazardous conditions and alerts the workers and the management. The system was developed using React, Python and Firebase.

projects.name: nirbhaya : women safety app
projects.description: a platform that is designed to help women travel safely and with confidence, by providing a variety of features that promote personal security.

projects.name: plant-it
projects.description: Plant-It serves as a comprehensive resource for gardening enthusiasts and farmers alike. By leveraging geolocation data and climate information, it offers personalized plant recommendations. Whether one seeks agricultural insights or aims to cultivate a small urban garden, Plant-It provides tailored guidance. Together, they explore the world of plants and nurture their green aspirations.

projects.name: param-linter
projects.description: An customized automation tool that allows web-application penetration testers to filter and enumerate website endpoints and the respective query parameters as per their requirement. It was developed using Python and Selenium.

projects.name: QuestGen: automated question generation system
projects.description: Developed a web application that generates questions automatically from text. The system employs Google's T5 model algorithms to generate questions and answers. The system was developed using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, and Flask.

projects.name: plant disease detector application
projects.description: Developed an Android app that identifies plant diseases from leaf images. Users receive disease diagnosis, remedies, and preventive measures. Leveraged Flutter for the front-end, Python for AI-ML models and APIs, and Firebase for image storage.

projects.name: student-faculty interaction system
projects.description: A mobile application that facilitates communication between students and faculty members. The application allows students to ask questions and get annoucements from faculty members. The application was developed using Flutter and Firebase for backend services.

projects.name: VaxNote
projects.description: A vaccination management system that allows users to store and manage their vaccination records digitally. The system also provides users with reminders for upcoming vaccinations and appointments. The system was developed using PHP and MySQL for backend services and Android (Java) for the front-end application.
